title: A dictator chose a king. The king gave Spain democracy.

beats.text: A dictator chose a king. The king gave Spain democracy.
After 1939, Franco ruled alone: prisons, censorship, hunger. Europe shut Spain out.
beats.say: After nineteen thirty-nine, Franco ruled alone: prisons, censorship, hunger. Europe shut Spain out.

beats.text: The Cold War rescued him. In 1953, American bases came to Spain, and American presidents to Madrid.
beats.say: The Cold War rescued him. In nineteen fifty-three, American bases came to Spain, and American presidents to Madrid.

beats.text: In the sixties, tourists and factories made Spain boom. But there were still no free elections.
In 1969 Franco named his heir: young Prince Juan Carlos. Everyone expected more of the same.
beats.say: In nineteen sixty-nine Franco named his heir: young Prince Juan Carlos. Everyone expected more of the same.

beats.text: In 1973, an ETA bomb killed Franco's prime minister. It threw his car over a five-storey building.
beats.say: In nineteen seventy-three, an ETA bomb killed Franco's prime minister. It threw his car over a five-storey building.

beats.text: Franco died in November 1975. Two days later, Juan Carlos became king.
beats.say: Franco died in November nineteen seventy-five. Two days later, Juan Carlos became king.

beats.text: He picked Adolfo Suárez, a man of the old regime, to take it apart. In 1977, Spain voted freely for the first time in forty-one years.
beats.say: He picked Adolfo Suárez, a man of the old regime, to take it apart. In nineteen seventy-seven, Spain voted freely for the first time in forty-one years.

beats.text: A year later, Spaniards approved a democratic constitution.
Then, in 1981, a Civil Guard colonel stormed parliament with armed men and held the deputies hostage.
beats.say: Then, in nineteen eighty-one, a Civil Guard colonel stormed parliament with armed men and held the deputies hostage.

beats.text: That night the king, in uniform, went on TV and ordered the army to stand by democracy. By the next day, the coup had collapsed.
The heir the dictator chose had saved the democracy.
